method.trigger: failed immediate DFS, exact resource denial before first static reachable branch, no budget exhaustion or route bound prune
method.future_search: one topology-only reverse-Dijkstra successor chain, intersect integer launch bits1..60 across every positive node and directed-edge entry calendar, then exact validate complete certificate
method.budget: freeze relative route excess at current actual attempt; future finish limit moves with proposed launch
method.information: only current committed reservations and known topology; safety queries reach goal; no future task access
method.end_time: does not clip future mask or future launch event
method.failure_count: immediate DFS failure still increments failed_attempts even if future rescue succeeds

schema_notes.source_reserve: owns complete rights, current_index=-1, not actual admission
schema_notes.source_launch: same IDs/generation, actual clock, increments old commit_order only now
schema_notes.future_reserved: ever successfully precommitted; remains true after launch
schema_notes.pending_original_fields: empty physical route and IDs; null actual admission/finish/commit fields; completed=false
schema_notes.audit_scope: new pending-rights auditor required; frozen006 audit files unchanged
